title: Board server-sent events
description: Each SSE frame has an event name and a string data line.

oneOf.title: open
oneOf.description: First frame of a connection; data names this backend run, so a page older than it can tell.

oneOf.title: beat
oneOf.description: Heartbeat; data is the interval in milliseconds the page may stay silent for.

oneOf.title: changed
oneOf.description: State was written; no payload, the page re-reads GET /api/tasks.
